ov: الخلاص (الإنجليزية: Deliverance) هو فيلم مغامرة تم إنتاجه في الولايات المتحدة وصدر في سنة 1972.
plotEn:
Four Atlanta businessmen go whitewater take a last canoe trip down the Cahulawassee River in the remote northern Georgia wilderness before the river is dammed and the valley flooded. Lewis Medlock, an avid survivalist, leads the group. Ed Gentry is also an outdoorsman, but lacks Lewis's self-confidence. Bobby Trippe and Drew Ballinger are novices. En route to their launch site, the men are rude toward the locals, who in turn become hostile to the "city boys". At a local gas station, Drew engages a young banjo-playing boy in a musical duel with his guitar. The duel is mutually enjoyable, and some of the locals break into dance at the sound of it. However, the boy does not acknowledge Drew when offered a friendly handshake.
They set off in two canoes, and become separated. Ed and Bobby leave the water and encounter a pair of mountain men in the woods, one carrying a shotgun and missing his two front teeth. The mountain men tie Ed to a tree and Bobby is forced to undress at gunpoint. The unarmed man rapes him, demanding that he "squeal like a pig". Before the mountain man can force themselves on Ed, Lewis arrives and kills the rapist with his bow and arrow. Ed snatches the shotgun and the other man flees. Lewis and Drew argue about what to do, and Ed and Bobby support Lewis' plan to bury the body and continue on as if nothing had happened.
